# agent-cost-allocator-mcp

> Agent Cost Allocator MCP — multi-tenant LLM cost attribution for chargeback billing. Companion to agent-token-budget. Splits one agent's spend across many tenants for invoicing. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- open_ledger
- record_charge
- tenant_chargeback_summary
- full_ledger_summary
- product_breakdown
- list_ledgers

## Install
```
pip install agent-cost-allocator-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/agent-cost-allocator-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
